complex.ref: g = 6.4 cm/s^2; simple-to-complex transition D_t = 39.7 g^-0.4 km (g in cm/s^2; icy-body fit of Aponte-Hernandez et al. 2021, PSJ 2:235, as stated in Bottke et al. 2024, PSJ, eq. 3), g = GM / R^2 from the JPL satellite physical parameters (solar-system.md 2.3); complex fresh depth d = 0.366 D^0.559 km (Schenk 1989, JGR 94:3813, the Rhea fit as reproduced in Stern, Porter & Zangari 2015, arXiv:1412.1405, eqs. 3-6; Cassini complex slopes 0.49-0.59 on Rhea, Iapetus and Mimas, White & Schenk 2011, LPSC 42 #2283); blended from D_t to 2 D_t

calibration.ref: NASA NSSDC fact sheet geometric albedo (solar-system.md 2.5)

procedural.ref: no measured colour index exists for Mimas (Pace 1971 lists only bracketed values without a reference; Morrison & Cruikshank 1974: photographic magnitudes only): neutral grey; brightening of fresh crater interiors and ejecta
